back_translation: Oh, all you who thirst, come to the waters! And you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without using money and without cost.
Why do you pay money for what is not food, and trade your labor for what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest food.
Incline your ear and come to me; listen, so that your soul may live, and I will make an everlasting covenant with you — the sure steadfast love I promised to David.
Behold, I have set him as a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander of the peoples.
Behold, you will call a nation you do not know, and nations that do not know you will run to you — for the sake of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has bestowed splendor on you.
Seek the LORD while he may be found; call upon him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the LORD, and he will have compassion on him, and to our God, for he will pardon overflowingly.
"For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways," declares the LORD.
"For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so my ways are higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts."
For as the rain and snow come down from heaven and do not return there until they have soaked the earth, making it bear and sprout, giving seed to the sower and food to the eater,
so will my word be that goes out from my mouth: it will not return to me empty, but it will do what I purpose, and it will succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
For you will go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and the hills will break out in song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
The cypress will grow up in place of the thornbush, and the myrtle will grow up in place of the nettle; and this will be a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign that will never be cut off.
